title: Norse Atlantic's Planes Get Repossessed, Qantas Picks a Side, and Americans Barely Fly
summary: Norse Atlantic's collapse gets uglier as lessors try to literally take the planes back mid-crisis. Qantas is about to hand Boeing a massive long-haul win over Airbus, and a new survey suggests America's "air travel obsession" might be a myth. Plus, Scott Kirby makes a bold Thanksgiving prediction.
